subject: SOC2: Pen test findings — evidence handoff and ETA for remediation
messages:
From: Penetration Labs <security@penetrationlab.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Redwood PT — follow-up and evidence request

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the engagement. We delivered the consolidated penetration test on 2027-04-26 (attached as redwood_pt_report_202704.pdf). Before we close our findings for your SOC2 pack, we need concrete evidence for a handful of medium/high items we flagged:

- AUTH-03 (token reuse / session invalidation): request evidence of token revocation flow + unit/integration test logs showing expired tokens are rejected.
- LOG-05 (insufficient privileged access logging): need sample logs (sanitized) showing elevated privilege events with user IDs and timestamps.
- SECRETS-02 (exposed credential in CI artifact): require keystore rotation proof + CI job change diff.
- NETWORK-04 (lack of segmentation for management network): summary of firewall rules + expected timeline for microsegmentation.

Preferred formats: PDF or text logs for evidence, diffs as .patch or .diff, screenshots for console state where applicable. If you prefer, we can accept a consolidated folder or a shared drive link.

Can you confirm owners and target ETA for each item? We try to keep our SOC2 attestations consistent so a reply by end-of-week would be ideal.

Thanks,
Simon Park
Penetration Labs
security@penetrationlab.com

Attachment: redwood_pt_report_202704.pdf (report, 3.2MB)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: security@penetrationlab.com, sec-ops@acme.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 14:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Redwood PT — follow-up and evidence request

Thanks Simon — appreciate the clear list. Laura / Evelyn, looping you both in to confirm owners and ETAs so we can bundle evidence for Acme and the SOC2 runner.

Quick assignment proposal:
- Laura Bennett: AUTH-03 (token lifecycle and revocation) + SECRETS-02 keystore rotation proof
- Evelyn Hart: LOG-05 (privileged access logging samples)
- Infra (I will loop Ops separately): NETWORK-04 microsegmentation plan and firewall diffs

Simon: we plan to provide diffs/patches and sanitized logs. A couple of clarifications before we hand over:
1) For AUTH-03, do you need live replay steps or are unit/integration test logs sufficient?
2) For LOG-05, please confirm acceptable redaction policy (we will strip PII and replace usernames with stable pseudonyms).
3) For SECRETS-02, we rotated the affected keystore but can provide rotation logs; do you need KMS audit entries as well?

I propose a 30-minute sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to confirm formats and any outstanding expectations. If that works for you, I'll send a calendar invite.

Jonas
VP, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.com, security@penetrationlab.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 15:48:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Redwood PT — follow-up and evidence request

Jonas / team / Simon,

Quick status update and evidence handoff for the items assigned to our squad:

- AUTH-03 (token revocation / session invalidation) — CLOSED: pushed change to identity-service to invalidate refresh tokens on rotate and added test coverage. Evidence attached: auth-fix-diff.patch (code diff) and a short run log showing failed-replay attempts. We also exported CI integration test output that demonstrates expiry behavior.

- SECRETS-02 (keystore rotation) — PARTIAL: rotation completed for the flagged key on 2027-05-10 at 03:22 UTC. Keystore rotation record attached (keystore-rotation-log.txt). We rotated via our KMS and updated CI job that previously leaked the artifact. CI change is in a PR (link below); will push patch diff to the shared drive by EOD.

- LOG-05 — Evelyn is collecting sanitized log samples; she will deliver a tarball of three event types (privilege-escalation, admin-login, role-change) with pseudonymized identifiers by 2027-05-12.

- NETWORK-04 — Infra has triaged and started a microsegmentation sprint; current ETA is 2027-05-16. I will include firewall rule diffs and a short runbook for validation once complete.

Attachments: auth-fix-diff.patch, keystore-rotation-log.txt
Links: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/pt-remediation/ACME-2027/notes (contains PRs, screenshots, and CI links)

Simon - if the attached artifacts are acceptable, we can mark AUTH-03 as remediated for the SOC2 evidence package. For secrets and network, I'll update you as soon as the infra items produce diffs/audit logs.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Engineering Manager, Identity & Access
Redwood Inference
